SPY.title: Trump Vs. Harris: How Their Fiscal Plans Could Add Trillions To The US National Debt
SPY.description: The fiscal plans proposed by former President Donald Trump and Vice President Kamala Harris would both significantly increase the U.S. national debt, with Trump's plan adding an estimated $7.75 trillion and Harris's plan adding $3.95 trillion by 2035. The rising debt levels could put pressure on the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates, further escalating the government's interest expenses.
SPY.author: Piero Cingari

SPY.title: US Consumer Confidence Rises Strongly In October: Stock Market Sentiment Hits New Highs
SPY.description: US consumer confidence surged in October, with the Consumer Confidence Index jumping to 108.7 from 99.2 in September. Consumers were more optimistic about current business and labor market conditions, and a record-high 51.4% expected stock prices to rise over the next year.
SPY.author: Piero Cingari
